author: PixelFatigue
quote: Metroid Prime 4 Beyond is a massive disappointment that completely ruins the franchise by trading its signature isolation for tedious open world padding, annoying side characters, and outdated gameplay mechanics. After waiting nearly a decade, Retro Studios delivered a dated action game that forces you through Sol Valley, which is a giant and lifeless desert hub built solely for mandatory green crystal grinding. The game completely destroys its haunting sci-fi atmosphere by introducing a goofy squad of Galactic Federation troopers who constantly blast you with cringy dialogue and spoil puzzle solutions before you can even think. Compounding this torture is a stuck in 2002 gameplay loop featuring boring lock and key upgrades, useless missiles that deal less damage than standard beam shots, and a tedious scanning mechanic. It is a fragmented, hand holding mess that strips away everything that made the original trilogy great, leaving behind an uninspired 1 out of 10 disaster.
